title: v-PPL: Visual-grounded Perplexity for Fine-grained Image-Text Alignment Evaluation in Long Text Scenarios
description: A novel evaluation metric that grounds perplexity in visual content, going beyond coarse CLIP scores to reward precise, detail-aware matching in long-text image-text alignment.

title: FineLongCLIP: Advancing Fine-Grained Image-Text Matching via a Dual-Branch Visual Encoder Capturing Global and Detailed Features
description: A dual-branch visual encoder with adaptive attention optimization that aligns long texts with both global semantics and local visual details, achieving SOTA fine-grained image-text matching across four datasets.
